ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left picture is a piece of paper drawn with lines similar to a 3×3 grid, the middle area is empty, and some line segments around it are labeled with numbers 1 to 8. The right picture shows the shape after folding: near the center there is a flat cross-shaped part, and in each of the four corner directions there is an upright folded flap. Reasoning: According to the correspondence between the left and right pictures, the ones that can form the four upright folded flaps in the right picture are the labeled lines corresponding to the four corner positions in the left picture, namely 2, 4, 6, 8. Therefore the sum of the numbers on the cut-open lines is 2+4+6+8=20.

method.method_draft: Image: The left panel shows an unfolded 3×3-style layout with labels around a blank center; the right panel shows the folded state with four vertical flaps, one at each corner position of the unfolded pattern. Text: The question asks for the total of the numbers on the lines that were cut. Bridge: Use the fold correspondence—each corner-positioned labeled line in the flat figure becomes one of the lifted flaps in the folded figure, so the cut lines are the corner labels 2, 4, 6, and 8. Add them: 2+4+6+8=20.

In the unfolded picture, the labels are 1 through 8 around a center. Text: We need the sum of the labels on cut lines. Bridge: Instead of summing the cut lines directly, sum all labels and subtract the labels that stay uncut/flat; the flat, uncut positions are 1, 3, 5, and 7, so the cut total is (1+2+3+4+5+6+7+8)−(1+3+5+7)=36−16=20.
